documentation.description: Returns index mappings in cursor-paginated pages.

index.description: A comma-separated list of index names

size.description: Maximum number of index mappings in a page

sort.description: Sort order for concrete index names

next_token.description: Cursor returned by a previous list mappings request

ignore_unavailable.description: Whether specified concrete indices should be ignored when unavailable (missing or closed)

allow_no_indices.description: Whether to ignore if a wildcard indices expression resolves into no concrete indices

expand_wildcards.description: Whether to expand wildcard expression to concrete indices that are open, closed, or both

cluster_manager_timeout.description: Specify timeout for connection to cluster-manager node

local.description: Return local information, do not retrieve the state from cluster-manager node
